# BigQuery's documentation gives (value, value, ...) for %T of a STRUCT, where GoogleSQL writes a
# STRUCT of one field as STRUCT(value), as its literal syntax requires.
SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(STRUCT('foo' AS a) AS a)]) AS s
?>

# BigQuery ends %t at the NUL of a STRING element of an ARRAY; see whether a STRUCT field does too.
SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(STRUCT(CONCAT('a', CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([0]), 'b') AS x, 1 AS y) AS a)]) AS s
?>
